preorder([X], [X]):-!.
preorder([X|T], L):-
    preorder(X, L1),
    preorder(T, L2),
    append(L1, L2, L3),
    append([X], L3, L).
 
height([], 0):-!.
height([_], 1):-!.
height([_|T], H):-
    height(T, H1),
    H is H1 + 1.
